facts.fact: DLA Piper's guide, last modified 17 February 2026, lists the Electronic Transactions Law (Law no. 3/2017 of 9 January) among Mozambique's laws in force and cites its rules on electronic marketing consent, intermediary service providers and personal data, with fines for breach.

DLA Piper's guide, last modified 17 February 2026, says Decree no. 59/2023 of 27 October (amended by Decree no. 44/2025 of 28 November) requires intermediary electronic service providers, a category the Electronic Transactions Law defines, and digital platform operators to register and be licensed with INTIC.
